cornerCallouts: Here they come into Curva da Mata, a tricky downhill right-hander that demands precision.
Drivers need to be patient through Curva do Lago, setting themselves up for a good exit onto the back straight.
They're attacking the Descida do Lago now, a crucial section for overtaking opportunities.
The braking zone for Curva do Pinheirinho is always critical, easy to lock up under pressure.
It's all about carrying speed through Curva do Saca Rolha, maintaining momentum through the chicane.
Drivers thread the needle through the Curva dos Cafezais, a sequence of flowing corners that reward bravery.
Now into the long sweeping bend of Curva da Ferradura, where the car really loads up.
The final corner, Curva 1, is key to a good run down the start-finish straight. Get it wrong, and you pay the price.
strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor on this 3.444km layout. Managing the rubber through the long corners will be key to a successful race.
The pit window here is relatively short, meaning teams will need to execute their stops flawlessly.
Fuel consumption will be a concern, especially in the closing stages of the race. Expect some careful management from the drivers.
A well-timed safety car could dramatically alter the race. Keep an eye on incidents around the Curva da Mata.
The abrasive surface of Velo Città will punish the tires, leading to some interesting strategic choices.
With limited overtaking opportunities, track position is crucial. A strong qualifying performance is paramount.
The elevation changes put extra stress on the engines, so reliability will be a key factor.
Teams will be closely monitoring the weather radar. A sudden downpour could throw the entire race into chaos.
weatherCommentary: The humidity here in Brazil can be brutal, impacting both the drivers and the cars.

The sun is beating down relentlessly today. Expect track temperatures to soar, affecting tire performance.
A light breeze is blowing across the circuit, which could help to cool the tires slightly.
The air is heavy with moisture, making it difficult for the drivers to stay cool and focused.
